maria.kapoor: Cutting RC candidate 2026.3.18-rc1 now. Artifacts at https://artifacts.internal/rc/2026.3.18. Deploy window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need QA + oncall signoff for greenlight. DB migration flag ready? @alex_rhee

deploy-bot: CI ✅  All checks passed. Canary smoke: ok. Readiness: ok. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rc-promo

alex_rhee: DB migration is behind a feature flag (enable_new_index=false). No offline migrations. Build tag: abcdef12. If we need to rollback we can flip flag.

samuel: Reviewed release notes, nothing user-visible. +1 from product docs.

jordans: QA smoke on staging completed. Telemetry: no error spikes. One flaky integ test retried and passed. @sre_oncall can you confirm latency SLOs?

sre_oncall: Observability green. KV cache warm ~85%. 99p latency within SLO. Approve canary :thumbsup:

maria.kapoor: Scheduling canary at 02:10 UTC. Rolling plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100%. Pin fallback to v1.2.3. Deploybot: execute when ready.

deploy-bot: /deploy promote --rc 2026.3.18 --strategy staged --canary 5,25,100 --fallback v1.2.3
Status: initiated
Stage 0: orchestration locked
Stage 1: canary group created

alex_rhee: seeing 503s on canary node after ~7m. Redis timeouts in app logs:
```
ERROR redis: timeout waiting for reply
stack: net/redis/conn.go:223
```
Pausing rollout. Will triage.

sre_oncall: Pausing rollout now. Executing rollback to fallback.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: /deploy rollback --target canary-2026.3.18
Status: rollback completed. Traffic restored to v1.2.3. Incident INC-2026-45 created. :warning:

maria.kapoor: Hold promo. Next steps: alex to debug redis client change and run extended smoke; QA to run 15m extended smoke; reschedule window to 04:00 UTC if fixed. @samuel update release notes status to 'on hold'.

samuel: Updated notes and release dashboard: https://releases.internal/2026.3.18. Will ping when all clear.

jordans: Extended smoke queued and running — will report results here.

sre_oncall: Tagging @redis-eng for visibility and adding postmortem checklist to INC-2026-45. Keep me posted.
